data.title: bn-20h: Bound Teapot invocation and diagnostics
data.description: For bn-20h: use operator-bound structured argv for the frozen read and dry-run commands, check engine identity and enforcement, preserve native and wrapper exits, and reject invalid JSON. Session checks send only when expressly dispatched by the caller. Validate the full frozen binary case against an owned loopback fixture.

data.body: [MEDIUM, blocking] Every adapter operation waits on Command::output(), which buffers all stdout and stderr before parsing and has no wall-clock deadline. The JSON parser rejects malformed or multiple values but imposes no byte limit. The frozen 16 MiB constant only describes Teapot socket frames and provides no bound for a wrapper pipe. The pinned Teapot CLI also defaults to no request read timeout after the handshake, so a stalled native command can hold even passive describe indefinitely. Add finite execution and capture bounds with typed errors, reap the local subprocess on either limit, and test each stream and a deadline. For check-session, timing out the caller does not establish an absence of traffic.

data.reason: th-3h9qc1: Bound stdout and stderr capture and give each native invocation a finite deadline. The five focused tests, exact pinned loopback conformance and full just check passed. The pinned test observed zero HTTP requests from passive operations and two from explicit check-session. Separate identity probes detect observed engine changes without atomically binding dispatch.

data.body:
Implemented the fix in fc9cdde45eb166e34edfd8a0ef622128586c4e88. Verified workspace HEAD 3d729a829a6d1c3076348310e3521d0df5895097 and base 3b33d8ad7574dc866013abfe83d1536b11e85519. In crates/scourge-core/src/teapot/process.rs:62, each child starts in a private process group under a 120-second deadline. The poll loop at line 144 services both pipes, the collector at line 245 limits each to 16 MiB plus one newline before growing buffers, and cleanup at line 116 kills the group and reaps its leader. In crates/scourge-core/src/teapot/mod.rs:528, timeout maps to TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE and overflow to INVALID_NATIVE_OUTPUT, with registered DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE, bounded redacted text and authentic local exit status. Timeout does not establish that a session probe was unsent.

All six fake-child cases passed, including deadline after valid output, simultaneous pipe pressure, both stream floods, strict JSON, reaping and a wrapper exit retained while a helper held its pipe. All seven adapter cases passed against the pinned Teapot suite or synthetic wrappers. Jobs reject oversize pages, repeated IDs and cursor violations. The live fixture observed zero passive requests and two opt-in probes without credential headers. Full just check and git diff --check passed on the exact replayed target.

data.reason: Verified on synced target 3d729a829a6d1c3076348310e3521d0df5895097. Production calls use bounded concurrent pipe capture and a 120-second Linux polling deadline. Cleanup signals the private group before reaping the leader. Capture failures discard partial output and report a redacted typed reason with observed process status only. All six transport and seven adapter tests plus native just check passed. The local deadline does not establish whether the engine dispatched a session probe.

Verified the resolved capture and deadline fix on the exact synced target. Six transport tests, seven adapter tests including exact pinned Teapot, and full native just check passed. Job pages enforce size, unique IDs and the exclusive cursor. The disposable fixture observed zero passive requests and two explicit session probes without Cookie, Authorization, Proxy-Authorization or X-API-Key. Product lane blobs match pre-sync, with sibling changes preserved in shared files.
